notes: Bands follow the PRD weights with the certainty the prompt asks for. The cooler golden has a certainty so the replay asserts the pipeline puts it in Ignore; a model that leaves it out also passes. Open question for the PM (same family as fixture 09): a hedged offer with a date ('maybe ... this weekend') scores 0.25 and is never shown, while the undated hedged intention (camping) is shown as Also noticed.

items.title: Priya to return the tent
items.quote: I'll get it back to you soon, promise
items.note: A plain promise with vague timing: 'soon' gives no date. 0.80 + 0.05 exact = 0.85. Inventing a date (e.g. 'this weekend' from the cooler line) is a date-accuracy error.

items.title: Another camping trip with Priya
items.quote: we should do another camping trip sometime
items.note: Hedged intention, like the D36 lunch: 0.30 + 0.05 = 0.35, Also noticed. Owner 'user' because 'we' includes the user, as in fixture 01.

items.title: Lake photos from Priya
items.quote: can you send me the photos from the lake when you get a chance?
items.note: Sam (the user) asked and Priya agreed ('yes will do'), so the user is waiting on Priya. Typing it as a request to the user would be an owner error. 0.85.

items.title: Priya to return the cooler
items.quote: maybe I can return your cooler this weekend too
items.note: Hedged offer: 0.30 + 0.05 exact + 0.05 date agrees - 0.15 hedge = 0.25, Ignore. 'this weekend' names a period, so chrono's Sat Oct 24 would be Assumed. Pass if left out or scored Ignore.
